'''''Scouter''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The transport participated in the [[mission at Argoon]], attacking an abandoned cargo area near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argoon]]. The transport was destroyed in the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Scouter'' was a transport ship that appeared in the PC Game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] in Battle 3 Mission 1 as an enemy target. The transport was considered a bonus objective to be destroyed.
